title: JGM2 higher-degree/order shared-state acceleration ladder
scientific_cautions: This is a shared-state acceleration implementation comparison, not a propagated short-arc or full-arc validation.
The frozen JGM2 file is copied read-only from the user's GMAT R2026a installation and checksum-recorded.
The independently validated full GMAT R2026a EOP rotation is reused for tesseral gravity.
Tides, drag, third bodies, solar radiation pressure, and relativity are disabled.
The preregistered thresholds must not be loosened merely to obtain a pass.
This is software-model agreement, not measured-orbit truth or flight qualification.
